subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Which Gateway resilience scope should OpenClaw core own now: current safe-mode diagnostics only, a narrow built-in watchdog, or a broader recovery ladder with config and notifications?
rationale: The requested behavior changes core availability, config surface, recovery automation, and security posture, so automation cannot safely choose the product semantics or defaults.

options.title: Sponsor a split core design
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for smaller maintainer-approved follow-ups covering one recovery tier at a time with security and upgrade proof.

options.title: Defer to existing diagnostics
options.body: Keep current safe-mode, health, and stability diagnostics as the core behavior and decline a built-in recovery ladder for now.

options.title: Adopt the watchdog PR path
options.body: Use the open watchdog-core PR as the implementation track after it resolves proof, conflict, compatibility, and security concerns.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a split core design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for smaller maintainer-approved follow-ups covering one recovery tier at a time with security and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Gateway crash-loop breaker and related runtime resilience code in this checkout trace to Shakker's commit, making that the strongest source-history routing signal available.
